title: Dead DOI 10.1023/A:1013940928637 + wrong 'Van Camp et al. 2001' attribution contaminate WIN-012, WIN-013 (x2), and data/sections.json (x2) — same critical error fixed in WIN-011 by EXP-601
description: ISS-2638/EXP-601 fixed the dead DOI and wrong-author attribution in WIN-011 only. Grep this run shows the identical dead DOI (doi.org handle API responseCode=100, re-confirmed) also appears in: (1) WIN-012 detail ('0.0 uGal at Membach during the August 1999 eclipse (Van Camp et al., 2001)'), (2) WIN-013 detail twice, (3) data/sections.json twice. The four-SG 1999-eclipse study is Mansinha, Ducarme, Hinderer, Meurers & van Ruymbeke (2001), J. Geod. Soc. Japan 47(1), 387-391 — working J-STAGE DOI 10.11366/sokuchi1954.47.387 (handle-verified this run; supersedes c6's 'no DOI exists'). Van Camp is not an author. ADDITIONAL FLAG, possibly its own issue: WIN-013 asserts the DOME printed this citation ("the dome's printed citation ('Van Camp et al. 2001, Phys. Earth Planet. Inter.', DOI 10.1023/A:1013940928637) does not resolve") — but the dome's raw text (raw-text/02-wins.txt:89) says only 'Source: Van Camp 1999. 0.0 uGal.' with NO DOI and NO journal. If the dome never printed that DOI, our WIN-013 attributes our own citation error to the dome — a fabricated-attribution bug worse than a dead link. Needs verification against the dome's full WIN-013 source text before patching. Also note WIN-012/WIN-013 cite the Membach value as 0.0 uGal under this DOI; Mansinha et al. covers Membach among its four stations, but the per-station '0.0 uGal' figure and the dome's separate 'Van Camp 1999' reference need re-verification against real sources (there exist genuine Van Camp Membach SG publications) before deciding whether the right fix is re-attribution to Mansinha or to an actual Van Camp paper.
recommended_action: Route to analyst as citation-verification EXP (class_hint=verification or deep-attack if the WIN-013 fabricated-attribution flag is confirmed). Re-verify what the dome actually cites for WIN-013, identify whether a real Van Camp Membach-1999-eclipse publication exists, then patch all five occurrences consistently with EXP-601's WIN-011 fix.
